publication_age_basis: UTC midnight of source date; uncertain proxy, not verified publication time
primary_metric: paired evaluation log loss, equal weight per company-day; date-block uncertainty; mean seed losses
stop_rule: one predeclared half-life; no tuning, automatic retries or further model/dataset changes
study_scope: exploratory relative recency comparison on inspected development periods; no causal, publication-diffusion or trading claim
age_diagnostic: mask each arrival-session-age bin 0..4 independently in selected raw models; fixed-model loss sensitivity with renormalization; all matched dates, coverage and conditional date-block uncertainty
